name: GCCE–VCTAGE Causal Admissibility Benchmark
description: This technical report presents the GCCE–VCTAGE Causal Admissibility Benchmark, an executable framework for evaluating whether agentic state transitions should be permitted to acquire operational authority. Grandić Causal Chain Enforcement (GCCE) provides a forward-only, back-checkable causal-provenance architecture in which present operational legitimacy depends on a reconstructable and legitimate ancestry whose committed history cannot be silently rewritten without invalidating inherited integrity evidence. VCTAGE — Verbatim, Causal Context, Timing/Causal Event Order, Authority, Goal, and Effect — provides a six-dimensional transition-correspondence vector that tests whether a proposed successor state remains aligned with the evidence, causal context, event order, authority, objective, and operational consequence under which execution is permitted. GCCE_VCTAGE_Causal_Admissibilit… The combined benchmark operationalizes a central question: HOW are you here? Rather than accepting narrative justification, semantic plausibility, or self-asserted authority, the gate requires a reconstructable causal authority lineage and correspondence between that lineage and the proposed transition. Operational authority is therefore treated as externally verifiable rather than narratively self-declared. GCCE_VCTAGE_Causal_Admissibilit… Phase 1 evaluated the reference gate using 12 deterministic cases and 10,000 randomized transitions.
